items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: He was originally the drummer. In fact, he drummed several times when he'd come over -- you know -- come up and play a few sets and things like that.

ctx.x: Yeah, the Club Alabam. So it was quite a good entertaining thing you know to play music in those days. It was --
Whom did you play with with Curtis Moseby?
Oh, gee I can't remember half the names. I can't even hardly remember the personnel of the band. I know Marshall Royal was one. And gee, I don't remember too many of the fellows.
